title: trifolium campestre var. majus
intro: Trifolium campestre var. majus, commonly known as large hop clover, is a variety of the perennial herb Trifolium campestre. It is a legume native to Europe and Asia, known for its medicinal properties and ability to fix nitrogen in the soil. Large hop clover has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including respiratory issues and digestive problems, due to its therapeutic actions of expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which may contribute to its potential health benefits, such as antioxidant and antimicrobial activities.
